name: Euphoria verticalis
intro: I photographed a pinned adult of this dark flower scarab with its specimen label. I use this specimen as an adult comparison. The label and the beetle are visible together in the photograph.

sections.title: Comparing adults
sections.text: The photograph shows the outline of the beetle from above. Compare the rounded pronotum, the surface of the wing covers and the overall shape together. Orozco’s revision of Euphoria treats E. verticalis in its own species group and provides the comparative basis for identification. A specimen image of this kind is useful for checking an adult determination before assigning the same name to associated immature stages.

sources.title: Alan Jeon, preserved Euphoria verticalis adult
J. Orozco (2012), Monographic revision of the American genus Euphoria
